title: Sadness
summary: SAD'NESS, noun 1. Sorrowfulness; mournfulness; dejection of mind; as grief and sadness at the memory of sin. 2. A melancholy look; gloom of countenance. Dim sadness did not spare Celestial visages. 3.

inlines.v: SAD'NESS, noun 1. Sorrowfulness; mournfulness; dejection of mind; as grief and sadness at the memory of sin. 2. A melancholy look; gloom of countenance. Dim sadness did not spare Celestial visages. 3. Seriousness; sedate gravity. Let every thing in a mournful subject have an air of sadness
